Option 1 — Provisional Tier Elevation (fastest):

- Prorated charge for the days elevated.
- One-off usage credit (applied after invoice) up to 20% of the uplift amount for first-time short windows.

Option 2 — Overrun True-up (safer):
- Keep current tier, allow overrun at standard overrun rate.
- Post-period true-up with a 10% concession on the overrun portion.

Operational notes:
